registered_modules.name: provenance

registered_modules.name: sholl
registered_modules.description: Annular occupancy and skeleton crossings around each cell soma, at two ring widths

registered_modules.name: surveillance

registered_modules.name: territory

registered_modules.name: coupling
registered_modules.description: Gap-respecting lag profiles and between-cell phase similarity

registered_modules.name: history
registered_modules.description: The tracker's own record of why a name is missing, hidden or renamed

registered_modules.name: recurrence

registered_modules.name: regimes

registered_modules.name: rhythms
registered_modules.description: Circadian Workbench rhythm tests and period estimates per cell and measurement

registered_modules.name: sequence_distance
registered_modules.description: How alike two cells' state sequences are, allowing one to run late

registered_modules.name: territory_shape
registered_modules.description: Eventual territory against the cell that made it, per frame and per cell

registered_modules.name: trend
registered_modules.description: Robust and least-squares drift per cell per measurement over the whole recording

registered_modules.name: walk
registered_modules.description: Step direction, turning angles, directional persistence and run lengths
